name: Counterparty with opaque UBO structure
description: Customer or supplier ownership cannot be unwound to a natural person. Cover for sanctions, AML, ABC, tax evasion.

name: Counterparty matches sanctions / PEP list
description: Inbound or outbound transaction with a sanctioned or PEP party that was not screened in time.

name: Cash payment over EU 10k threshold
description: Cash inflow or outflow exceeding EU 10k EUR (or stricter local) without CDD or reporting.

name: Records demanded by regulator / FIU not available
description: Inspector or FIU asks for CDD / monitoring / screening / training records and they cannot be produced.

name: Suspicion identified but no STR / SAR filed
description: Member of staff (or owner) becomes aware of suspicious activity and there is no pathway to file an STR / SAR.
